cards.text: It's the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, and the word of the LORD comes to Jeremiah the prophet. And baker, this assignment? STRANGE one. God sends Jeremiah to a family called the Rechabites and tells him to bring them into one of the rooms of the house of the LORD.

cards.question: God tells Jeremiah to bring the Rechabites into a room in the house of the LORD and offer them a drink of ___.

cards.text: So Jeremiah gathers the entire house of the Rechabites, starting with Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah. Same name, different Jeremiah, friend. Our prophet's father is Hilkiah (Jeremiah 1:1).
He brings them into the room of the sons of Hanan, a man of God, right next to the officials' room. Nothing like an audience, huh?
Jeremiah sets pitchers full of wine and some cups in front of the Rechabite men. Then he tells them, "Drink some wine."

cards.question: The pitchers of wine are on the table, and the prophet Jeremiah tells the Rechabites to drink. True or false: the Rechabites drink some.
The Rechabites tell Jeremiah they don't drink wine because they were commanded not to. Who gave them that command?

answers.text: Their forefather Jonadab son of Rechab

cards.text: And Jonadab didn't stop at wine. He told them, "Nor are you ever to build a house or sow seed or plant a vineyard." Baker, that's not a house rule. They don't even GET a house!

cards.question: No houses for the Rechabites. Their forefather Jonadab told them to live in ___ all their lives.
Jonadab gave the Rechabites a reason for living in tents and never planting or building. What was it?

answers.text: So they could live a long time in the land
So they could always be ready for war
So they could stay far away from kings

cards.question: True or false: the Rechabites say only the men of the family have kept Jonadab's command not to drink wine.

cards.text: No houses, no vineyards, no fields, no crops. They've done exactly as Jonadab commanded. Meanwhile, I once promised myself I'd stop sneaking chocolate chips. Lasted ONE batch.
But hold on. These are tent people, and right now they're staying in Jerusalem. Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, has marched into the land.

cards.question: When Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched into the land, why did the tent-dwelling Rechabites go into Jerusalem?

answers.text: To escape the armies coming in
To join the army of Judah
To buy land and finally settle

cards.text: Then the word of the LORD comes to Jeremiah again. This time he's sent to the men of Judah and the people of Jerusalem. God's question for them: 'Will you not accept discipline and obey My words?'

cards.question: Now God points Judah to the Rechabites. What does He say about the words their forefather Jonadab gave them?

answers.text: They were too hard to keep

cards.text: Jonadab's sons haven't drunk wine to this very day, because they obeyed their forefather. ONE forefather. ONE command. Still going STRONG.

cards.question: True or false: God tells the people of Judah that He has spoken to them only once.

cards.text: And it wasn't just God speaking to them. Again and again, He sent all His servants the prophets.

cards.question: What did God's prophets keep telling the people of Judah to do?
God's prophets also warned Judah not to go after other ___ to serve them.

cards.text: But the people have not inclined their ear or listened. God sets it side by side: the sons of Jonadab carried out their forefather's command, but these people have not listened to Him. Ooh, baker. That comparison STINGS.

cards.question: So God says He will bring on Judah and all the residents of Jerusalem all the ___ He has pronounced against them.
True or false: God says this disaster comes on Judah because He spoke to them and they did not obey, and He called to them and they did not answer.

cards.text: Then Jeremiah turns to the Rechabites with a word from the LORD of Hosts. They obeyed Jonadab, kept all his commandments, and did all he charged them to do.

cards.question: Because the Rechabites obeyed their forefather, what does the LORD of Hosts promise the family of Jonadab son of Rechab?

answers.text: A man to stand before God always
Fields and vineyards of their own

cards.text: Jonadab son of Rechab will never fail to have a man to stand before the LORD. Not bad for a family that never even built a house.

findings.problem: The opening card has 4 sentences: 'It's the days of... prophet.' / 'And baker, this assignment?' / 'STRANGE one.' / 'God sends Jeremiah...'. The limit for the opening card is 3.

rule.text: The opening card can be up to 3 sentences. It says who is speaking, to whom, and what is going on.

findings.problem: The card says the room is 'right next to the officials' room.' Jeremiah 35:4 says the room 'was near the chamber of the officials.' 'Right next to' tightens what the text says.

rule.text: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.

findings.problem: The right answer, 'Their forefather Jonadab son of Rechab', echoes the family name 'Rechabites', which the earlier cards already used. That makes it stand out from 'The prophet Elijah the Tishbite' and 'King Josiah of Judah'. The baker can match the name without reasoning about the passage.

findings.problem: 'ONE command' contradicts the passage. Jonadab gave several commands: no wine, no house, no sowing seed, no vineyard, live in tents (Jeremiah 35:6-7). Verse 18 says they 'kept all his commandments.'
